title: Prior Authorisation Categories and Decision Time Standards by Ridgecrest Advantage Plan
content:
The benefit categories needing prior authorisation before the service is rendered, and the time standards within which a coverage request must be decided, are fixed by the Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan the member holds.

| Plan | Standard initial determination (calendar days) | Expedited initial determination (hours) | Extension available once (calendar days) | Standard reconsideration (calendar days) | Expedited reconsideration (hours) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | 14 | 72 | 14 | 30 | 72 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | 14 | 72 | 14 | 30 | 72 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | 14 | 72 | 14 | 30 | 72 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | 14 | 72 | 14 | 30 | 72 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | 14 | 72 | 14 | 30 | 72 |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | 10 | 48 | 14 | 21 | 72 |

### Benefit categories needing prior authorisation

| Plan | Categories |
| --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Value (HMO) | acute inpatient care, outpatient surgery, advanced diagnostic imaging, skilled nursing facility care, durable medical equipment, Part B administered drugs |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Essential (HMO) | acute inpatient care, outpatient surgery, advanced diagnostic imaging, skilled nursing facility care, durable medical equipment, Part B administered drugs |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Plus (HMO-POS) | acute inpatient care, outpatient surgery, skilled nursing facility care, durable medical equipment, Part B administered drugs |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Premier (PPO) | acute inpatient care, outpatient surgery, skilled nursing facility care, Part B administered drugs |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Signature (PPO) | acute inpatient care, skilled nursing facility care, Part B administered drugs |
| Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) | acute inpatient care, Part B administered drugs |

Ridgecrest Advantage Elite Choice (PPO) is the one plan whose standard figures differ from the rest, at 10 calendar days for a standard initial determination, 48 hours for an expedited one and 21 calendar days for a standard reconsideration; the extension figure of 14 calendar days and the expedited reconsideration figure of 72 hours are the same on all six plans. Acute inpatient care and Part B administered drugs need prior authorisation on every plan, and are the only two categories that do.
